title: Elisha and the Arameans at Dothan
description: The king of Aram is at war with Israel, but the prophet Elisha warns the king of Israel about the plans of the Arameans. The king of Aram sends a military force to Dothan to capture Elisha. Elisha's servant is frightened by the sight of the army, but Elisha prays for the Lord to open the servant's eyes, so that he sees the mountain full of horses and chariots of fire. Elisha asks the Lord to strike the Arameans with blindness and leads them to Samaria. There he asks the king of Israel to spare them, give them food and drink, and send them home. After this, the raiding bands of the Arameans did not come into Israel again.
